title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Marvel's Deadpool

paragraphs.text: Secret Lair Drop Series: Marvel's Deadpool is a drop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on April 1, 2025 (dubbed "April 'Pools Day").

This drop is a continuation of the collaboration between Hasbro ( Wizards of the Coast ) and Marvel Entertainment . It was also a tease for the 2025 Universes Beyond tentpole set Marvel's Spider-Man . Similar to the five drops in the Secret Lair Drop Series: Marvel Superdrop from November 2024, this drop features one of Marvel's iconic characters and includes a mechanically unique representation of that character alongside supporting cards.

The drop additionally was made available through local shops on April 25, 2025, in a bid to make mechanically unique cards available to a broader public. At WPN stores, the Secret Lair will be available exclusively as a non-foil product, while both a non-foil and foil version are available via the Secret Lair website.
As an extra, the drop comes with one of two surprise bonus cards.
